تكتنفون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَنِفُونَ (taktanifūna) /tak.ta.ni.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# تُكْتَنَفُونَ (tuktanafūna) /tuk.ta.na.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
